linkedin.link_placement: Links can be included in the post description or as a comment.
linkedin.tone_spacing: Use professional tone, proper grammar and spelling. Use bullet points or numbered lists to break up large blocks of text.
spam_triggers: Generic phrases like 'Apply now' or 'Click here'

facebook.link_placement: Links can be included in the post description.
facebook.tone_spacing: Use friendly tone, use emojis and short paragraphs to make posts more engaging.
spam_triggers: Generic phrases like 'Win a job' or 'Get hired today'

instagram.link_placement: Links cannot be included in the caption, but can be included in bio.
instagram.tone_spacing: Use visually appealing posts with high-quality images and short captions.
spam_triggers: Generic phrases like 'Follow us for job opportunities'

tiktok.link_placement: Links cannot be included in the bio, but can be included in the caption with a swipe-up link.
tiktok.tone_spacing: Use short, engaging captions and hashtags, and focus on visually appealing content.
spam_triggers: Generic phrases like 'Apply now' or 'Get hired today'
